Intrusión en la Pista

Any occurrence at an aerodrome involving the incorrect presence of an aircraft, vehicle, or person on the protected area of a surface designated for the landing and take-off of aircraft.

Quick answer: Any occurrence at an aerodrome involving the incorrect presence of an aircraft, vehicle, or person on the protected area of a surface designated for the landing and take-off of aircraft.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Intrusión en la Pista?

In this glossary, Intrusión en la Pista refers to: Any occurrence at an aerodrome involving the incorrect presence of an aircraft, vehicle, or person on the protected area of a surface designated for the landing and take-off of aircraft.

How is Intrusión en la Pista used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Torre, observamos una intrusión de vehículo en la pista cerca del punto de espera Alfa Dos, solicitamos verificación."

Why does Intrusión en la Pista matter in aviation?

Intrusión en la Pista matters because it supports clear communication in Emergencies contexts for Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, and EASA FCL.055.
